heading.title: Of the Execution of unprivileged Wills

article.title: Incorporation of papers by reference.
article.content: If a testator, in a will or codicil duly attested, refers to any other document then actually written as expressing any part of his intentions, such document shall be deemed to form a part of the will or codicil in which it is referred to.
article.html:
64Incorporation of papers by reference.

Section 64 · Part VI · Chapter III · page 29 of the Act

If a testator, in a will or codicil duly attested, refers to any other document then actually written as expressing any part of his intentions, such document shall be deemed to form a part of the will or codicil in which it is referred to.
